p: Represents a drawable text element that can be rendered onto a canvas. Instances of this class encapsulate text rendering properties such as the text content, position, font, and paint settings.
(string?) = label: Gets the label text to be rendered. This property contains the string value that represents the textual content associated with this drawing instance.
(SKFont?) = font: Gets the SKFont defining the font style and typeface used to render the text. This property specifies the visual appearance of the text, including weight, size, and family.
(Vector2) = position ?? Vector2.Zero: Gets the Vector2 representing the position of the text. This property defines the coordinates within the canvas where the text will be drawn.

(SKPaint?) { get; set } = paint: Gets or sets the SKPaint object used to define the paint style for rendering the text. This includes settings such as color, stroke, and fill for text drawing operations.

pre.code: public void Render(Gui gui, LayoutNode node, SKCanvas canvas)

p: Renders the specified text onto the provided canvas using the given parameters.

ul.li: gui (Gui): The GUI context used for rendering the text.
node (LayoutNode): The layout node that the text is associated with.
canvas (SKCanvas): The canvas onto which the text will be drawn.
